📺 Enlisted (2014)

Enlisted follows Staff Sergeant Pete Hill, a talented and dedicated U.S. Army soldier who is reassigned to a military base in Florida after an incident while serving overseas. Upon arriving, Pete is reunited with his two younger brothers, Derrick and Randy, who serve in a rear detachment unit responsible for supporting deployed soldiers and their families. While Pete takes his military responsibilities seriously, Derrick is sarcastic and rebellious, and Randy is enthusiastic but often clueless. Tasked with leading a group of unconventional soldiers, Pete struggles to maintain discipline while dealing with his brothers’ hilarious antics and his own personal challenges. As the brothers reconnect, they develop a stronger bond and discover the importance of supporting one another through difficult times. Starring Geoff Stults, Chris Lowell, Parker Young, and Keith David, the series combines military humor, heartfelt moments, and entertaining storytelling about brotherhood, teamwork, loyalty, sacrifice, and the meaning of family.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Military • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Kevin Biegel

📺 Seasons: 1 • 13 Episodes

📍 Setting: The fictional Fort McGee military base in Florida.

source_details.synopsis: Enlisted is an American sitcom that premiered January 10, 2014, on Fox. Fox placed a 13-episode order for the single-camera comedy in May 2013. Despite low ratings, the show received many good reviews. On March 26, 2014, Fox announced that from April 11, Kitchen Nightmares would be airing in Enlisted's timeslot – effectively removing Enlisted from the schedule after nine episodes had aired. On May 7, 2014, Fox canceled the series due to low ratings, but allowed the final four episodes to air in June. The entire first season was released on DVD on December 9, 2014.
